notes: Source: Panthers 2026 media guide. Season and game lists and the career TD/receptions/tackles top 3 are the 'RECORDS: REGULAR INDIVIDUAL' pages (PDF pages 329-336, printed pages 327-334); regular season only (postseason, team, opponent and rookie lists skipped).

Career pass_yds, rush_yds, rec_yds, int and sacks come from the 'CAREER LEADERS' tables (PDF pages 420-428), one row per Panthers player sorted by that stat; their top 3 rows were checked against the Records pages and agree. The Records page career top-3 lists for those five stats were not duplicated as separate lists.

career pass_td, rush_td, rec and rec_td each have a 'list' (the Records page top-3) and a 'column' (first 30 rows of the yards-sorted Career Leaders table) because the guide prints no longer ranked list for them; use the list for ranks 1-3 and the column to find ranks 4-5.

The Records pages print three lines per list and no rank numbers; 'rank' is the line position (equal values share the position, tie true). Lines like '2x, most recently, Adam Thielen, 2023' mean several holders share that value and only the most recent is named; those rows have tie true and a note, and the other holders are not printed.

The Career Leaders tables print no rank numbers; rank = position in the printed order, equal values (interceptions) share the position and are tie true. Names are reordered from 'Newton, Cam' to 'Cam Newton' (suffixes kept); 'raw' keeps the printed form. 'DJ Moore (Denniston)' is printed with that disambiguator in raw.

Game lists: dates are printed with 2-digit years (12/30/12); 'years' holds the same date with a 4-digit year (95-99 -> 19xx, 00-26 -> 20xx; the franchise began in 1995); 'raw' keeps the printed text. One guide typo: Steve Smith's 3-TD game is printed '9/16/072' (read as 9/16/07).
through_season 2025: the lists include 2025 entries (Bryce Young 448 yards at Atlanta 11/16/25, Rico Dowdle 206 yards vs Miami 10/5/25, Tetairoa McMillan 2025).

game rush_td has an extra row for DeAngelo Williams at Green Bay 11/30/08: the rushing list names only the most recent of its two 4-TD games, the other is named on page 329 under 'Most Touchdowns, Game' ([4 rush]); that row's raw is page 329's text.

complete_to for the Career Leaders tables counts the first rows transcribed for list kinds (pass_yds 54 = all rows printed in that table; the other tables continue for every player who ever recorded the stat) and the 30 rows given for column kinds.
Every career table row was read from 250 dpi crops; yards per attempt/reception/return and completion percentage were checked arithmetically against the printed Avg and PCT columns.
